links.outcome: LLM responses amplifying and expanding psychosis-spectrum interpretations over multi-turn dialogues
links.effect: Significant amplification in four domains (p < .05; d = 0.14-0.46) and domain expansion in 83.8% of dialogues (88/105; p < .001).
links.quote: Across dialogues, we observed significant amplification in four domains (  p < .05;  d = 0.14-0.46) and domain expansion in 83.8% of dialogues (88/105;  p < .001).

links.outcome: Multi-turn drift of AI responses beyond user's original concerns, intensifying interpretations
links.effect: AI responses systematically expanded and intensified user descriptions beyond initial input; domain expansion in 83.8% of dialogues (88/105).
links.quote: AI responses can systematically expand and intensify users' descriptions beyond their initial input.
